name: Dark humor
description: Dark, morbid and wicked humor. Strong stomachs only.

humor-negro-te-obligan-a-elegir-como-pal.text: You're forced to choose how you kick the bucket. Which one?

humor-negro-por-1-millon-de-euros-que-es.text: For 1 million euros, what would you be willing to do?
options: Spend a whole night in a morgue
Never speak to your best friend again
Eat something disgusting every day for a year

humor-negro-apocalipsis-y-hay-hambre-cua.text: Apocalypse, and you're starving. Which line do you cross first?

humor-negro-en-tu-funeral-que-prefieres-.text: At your funeral, what would you rather cause?

humor-negro-te-toca-un-superpoder-maldit.text: You get a cursed superpower. Which one can you live with?
options: Always coming back to life, in agony every time
Being immortal and watching everyone you love die

humor-negro-que-serias-capaz-de-hacer-co.text: What would you be capable of doing to avoid dying?
options: Spending the rest of your life in a cell

humor-negro-si-pudieras-presenciar-tu-pr.text: If you could watch your own death as a mere spectator (no pain), would you?

humor-negro-quien-fingiria-su-propia-mue.text: Who would fake their own death to get out of a mess?

humor-negro-a-quien-le-darias-un-punetaz.text: Who would you punch in the face for a million euros?

humor-negro-quien-se-reiria-sin-poder-pa.text: Who would get an uncontrollable fit of giggles in the middle of a funeral?

humor-negro-quien-sobreviviria-mas-tiemp.text: Who would survive the longest in The Purge?

humor-negro-que-dos-personas-esconderian.text: Which two people could hide a body together without getting caught?

humor-negro-del-1-al-10-que-probabilidad.text: On a scale of 1 to 10, how likely are you to end up in hell?

humor-negro-os-toca-limpiar-la-escena-de.text: You have to clean up a crime scene. Which team leaves no evidence behind?

humor-negro-en-teoria-eh-cual-seria-la-m.text: Purely hypothetically... what's the best way to get rid of a body? (one sentence)
